captions.detailed: A realistic 3D model of a modern internet router in dark grey/black. The main body is a flat rectangular box with rounded corners, sloped sides, and a series of parallel ventilation ridges on the top surface. Along the rear edge, four vertical cylindrical antennas are mounted on small rectangular bases. A thin light-blue translucent LED indicator strip runs horizontally along the front face of the router.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a dark grey internet router with four rear antennas. The main body should feature rounded corners, sloped sides, a series of parallel cooling ridges on top, a light-blue front indicator light, and four identical vertical antennas evenly spaced along the back.
captions.factory: The main body is constructed using a Box primitive with chamfered or filleted edges to create the sloped, rounded router chassis. The top ventilation ridges are generated by repeating thin, long Box shapes across the top surface. The front LED strip is a thin colored box booleaned or positioned on the front face. Each of the four antennas is built as a multi-stage cylinder with a spherical tip on a small rectangular base, spaced linearly along the rear edge using translation offsets.
